description: At prompt.submit, runs TypeSafe's two-request skill suggestion (rank every skill + gate nouls, then re-read the top three with their SKILL.md + one fits noul each) or the built-in classifier, and attaches the one winner's SKILL.md as a <skill_relevance> block. The engine's skill listing stays in place unless hideListing is on, so every skill remains loadable by name.
